stem.text: The graph shows how the rate of facilitated diffusion of substance X across a cell surface membrane changed as the concentration of substance X increased. All conditions, except for the concentration of substance X, were kept constant. Temperature was maintained at $15\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.

stem.alt: Graph of rate of facilitated diffusion against concentration of substance X, with points P and Q marked by arrows

stem.text: Which statement about the rate of facilitated diffusion is correct?

A.text: The rate of facilitated diffusion of substance X at Q will increase if the temperature is increased to $20\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.

B.text: The rate of facilitated diffusion of substance X at P will increase if the concentration of ATP is increased.

C.text: The rate of facilitated diffusion of substance X at Q will increase if the concentration of substance X is increased.

D.text: The rate of facilitated diffusion of substance X at P will increase if the length of time over which the rate is measured is increased.
